youtube_title: Hiccups That Won't Stop? Try This Instead | Body Fix #21 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #21. Hic... hic... 10 minutes and it won't stop, and your friend wants to SCARE you?
B is right. Hold your breath or sip ICE-COLD water slowly. It can reset the spasm.
Hiccups = a diaphragm spasm. Eating fast, fizzy drinks and spicy food trigger it.
Fix: Hold breath ~10 sec, sip cold water, suck a lemon, eat slower next time.
Red flags: Hiccups for 2+ days or trouble breathing/swallowing? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Hiccups
